# Vendored frontend assets

These files are checked in so the dashboard works without a CDN and can run
fully offline (including inside Docker).

| File | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bootstrap.min.css` | 5.3.3 | MIT | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css |
| `bootstrap.bundle.min.js` | 5.3.3 | MIT | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js |
| `chart.umd.min.js` | 4.4.3 | MIT | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.3/dist/chart.umd.min.js |
